/bin/sh -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: count_text.py
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    input_path = Path(\"input.txt\")
+
+    try:
+        text = input_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        print(\"input.txt not found\", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    summary = (
+        f\"Lines: {len(text.splitlines())}\\n\"
+        f\"Words: {len(text.split())}\\n\"
+        f\"Characters: {len(text)}\\n\"
+    )
+    Path(\"output.txt\").write_text(summary, encoding=\"utf-8\")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
PATCH
python3 count_text.py
printf '%s\\n' '--- output.txt ---'
cat output.txt"
